The most‑frequent systemic finding across OIG’s Healthcare Facility Inspection reports is the recommendation that **clinicians document medication reconciliation for every episode of care in which medications are administered, prescribed, or changed**. It appears in **36 of the 4 410 reports** that are in scope (≈ 0.8 % of all inspection reports).

The VA El Paso Healthcare System is **not** listed among the facilities that have this finding. The cluster’s member list (the 36 reports) does not include any report for the El Paso facility.
